product_name: Nothing Phone 4a 5G (White, 8GB RAM, 256GB Storage) | Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 | 6.78" 120Hz AMOLED Display | 50MP Triple Camera | 5400mAh Battery | 50W Fast Charging
description: ☆【RAM, ROM And Expandable】: 8GB/12GB RAM with 128GB/256GB internal storage for smooth multitasking, app usage and media storage; no expandable storage as card slot is not available; UFS 3.1 storage. ☆【Display】: Large 6.78-inch AMOLED display with 1224 x 2720 pixels resolution, 120Hz refresh rate, HDR10+ support, 2160Hz PWM, up to 1600 nits HBM and 4500 nits peak brightness; protected by Corning Gorilla Glass 7i. ☆【Camera】: Advanced triple rear camera setup with 50MP main camera with OIS, 50MP periscope telephoto camera with OIS and 3.5x optical zoom, 8MP ultrawide camera, plus 32MP front camera; supports 4K video recording, Ultra XDR, panorama, Dolby Vision HDR, gyro-EIS and OIS. ☆【Processor】: Powered by Qualcomm Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 processor with octa-core CPU and Adreno 810 GPU for responsive performance; runs on Android 16 with Nothing OS 4.1 and supports up to 3 major Android upgrades; supports 5G connectivity. ☆【Battery】: 5400mAh India battery with 50W wired fast charging; charging data as provided: up to 50% in 22 minutes and 100% in 64 minutes; includes USB Type-C, Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth 5.4, NFC, stereo speakers, in-display fingerprint sensor and IP64 dust and water resistance.
